scope: 18 consequential claims; source checks and interpretation boundaries. No new paid experiments and no complete rerun of stage judges or statistical scoring.

claims.claim: The harness connects model players to an actual RPG application.
claims.internal_assessment: Supported by the selected implementation and reports.
claims.warranted_wording_and_boundary: Describe persistent records, cards, preparation and routing as implemented components; do not describe every DM ruling as a mechanically guaranteed state transition.
claims.question_for_independent_reviewer: Inspect how a proposal reaches a handler and which changes are stored outside the narrative.

claims.claim: Some activity is self-selected within a strongly structured role and world.
claims.warranted_wording_and_boundary: No assigned quest outcome is narrower than no task, role, cue or plot pressure. The pure-world arm retains a conflicting Mystery and wonder instruction.
claims.question_for_independent_reviewer: Identify the precise player instructions and visible invitations before coding initiative.

claims.claim: The archive count and quotation audit establish provenance, not a uniform sample or semantic validation.
claims.internal_assessment: Mechanically verified inventory and text identity.
claims.warranted_wording_and_boundary: 82 full primary files comprise 61 solo RPG transcripts, nine full party tables and twelve engine episodes. The 347 displayed selections draw from 47 transcripts. Reports and code add eighteen files; the total is 100 frozen source files.
claims.question_for_independent_reviewer: Run the dependency-free verifier and inspect what is excluded from this archive before using any denominator.

claims.claim: The contribution is the implemented apparatus, progression of controls and broad evidence atlas.
claims.internal_assessment: Comparative editorial argument, scoped by fourteen primary works.
claims.warranted_wording_and_boundary: Do not claim that the game-master pattern, private goals, D&D tool use or persistent resources are world-first inventions. Do not infer superiority over systems that were not run head-to-head.
claims.question_for_independent_reviewer: Check the nearest works, their versions and the declared reading limits; assess the value of the concrete configuration and evidence produced here.
